request: Build a small Jac web app that remembers facts about each user from their chat messages. After each message the model extracts short facts (for example 'prefers tea'); for each fact a model decision returns ADD, UPDATE (replace a conflicting memory) or NOOP. Users can search their memories by keyword.
acceptance: When the decision is UPDATE for 'prefers coffee' over 'prefers tea', the user has exactly one drink preference and it is coffee.
A NOOP decision leaves the memory count unchanged; a message with no facts writes nothing.
User A's memories never appear in user B's search.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Call the model through byLLM (`by llm`); tests use MockLLM with scripted outputs and never call a real model or the network.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
